verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a live activity view, streaming log, or current-status indicator for a running Jules task. The closest items are completion or needs-input notifications, plan review, and post-hoc diffs. These are adjacent milestone and review features, not real-time observation of what the agent is doing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status
